2608.25854.title: Key Point Analysis Needs Structure Recovery: Task Definition, Dataset Diagnosis, and a Structure-Aware Benchmark
2608.25854.paper_summary: Key Point Analysis (KPA) aims to identify a concise set of key points that summarize a collection of arguments together with their prevalence. We argue that KPA is fundamentally a structured prediction problem that requires recovering semantic groupings, generating representative key points, ensuring coverage, and estimating prevalence. Under this formulation, we show that existing KPA benchmarks suffer from limitations in grouping quality, redundancy, coverage, and argument-key point mappings, causing ceiling violation and selection failure in reference-based evaluation. To support future research on true KPA, we introduce a structure-aware, distribution-sensitive benchmark built via a human-in-the-loop re-annotation. Human and LLM evaluations consistently show that the resulting structures yield more coherent groupings, higher-quality key points, better coverage, and more reliable prevalence estimates than existing annotations. We further release several annotation resources to support research on KPA evaluation, argument-key point matching, explainable KPA, and LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, and outline a research agenda for true KPA.
2608.25854.paper_summary_zh: 關鍵點分析 (KPA) 旨在識別一組簡明的關鍵點，總結一系列論點及其流行程度。我們認為 KPA 本質上是一個結構化預測問題，需要恢復語義分組、生成代表性關鍵點、確保覆蓋範圍以及估計流行程度。在這種表述下，我們顯示現有的 KPA 基準在分組質量、冗餘性、覆蓋範圍和論點-關鍵點映射方面存在限制，導致基於參考的評估中出現上限違規和選擇失敗。為了支持未來對真正 KPA 的研究，我們引入了一個結構感知、分佈敏感的基準，通過人類參與的重新標註構建而成。人類和 LLM 的評估一致顯示，所產生的結構產生了更連貫的分組、更高質量的關鍵點、更好的覆蓋範圍以及比現有標註更可靠的流行程度估計。我們進一步釋出幾個標註資源，以支持 KPA 評估、論點-關鍵點匹配、可解釋的 KPA 和 LLM 作為評審方法論的研究，並概述了真正 KPA 的研究議程。
2608.25854.author: Zhiqiang Shi et.al.
